description: This file defines the LogNode interface in the package com.example.android.common.logger, specifying a contract for logging components that can output log data to various targets and chain multiple log nodes together.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging system component that can output logs to one or more targets and chain log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Abstract method that instructs the first LogNode in the chain to print the provided log data, including priority level, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
